calls.title: GrowthBook<>Plusgrade contract review
calls.summary: The team convened to discuss a data privacy and security strategy, opting for a self-hosted version of GrowthBook to enhance data control and limit external exposure. Key points included the clarification that GrowthBook would only access aggregates from a read-only data warehouse, ensuring compliance and reducing legal complexities. A four-month pilot contract with non-refundable fees was established, requiring flexibility for contract finalization due to internal approvals involving the CFO. The pilot testing of GrowthBook’s solution is currently underway in a non-production environment to validate integration before broad rollout. A communication plan was set with a target completion date for contract and deployment by May 15.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, Self-hosted Deployment, Data Privacy, Contract Terms, Legal Review, Pricing and Discounts
